notes.title: We are still here and tinkering...
notes.notes:
Although we have done a terrible job keeping folks up-to-date with our progress, I assure you all **crickets** that we are still engaged.  Here are a few highlights, but first, dancing (why did we make this....because we could...and we thought it was funny.) 

[previewyoutube=fiiRN_NSWEk;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Updates[/b]
We are currently working to release two different builds of the game in 2025.  

A free-demo featuring the introduction of the game, accompanied by a short, for purchase, DLC Halloween excursion.  Both are intended to introduce players to the world we are creating and to obtain objective feedback we can incorporate into current chapters of the game actively being developed as I type. 

Well that's it for now, we hope to be more consistent in our updates going forward!
